figures.caption: Protective effect of WT1-pTj in vivo. (A) Lung colonization of B16F10-Nex2 endovenously inoculated in C57BL/6 mice. (B) Effect of WT1-pTj on subcutaneous growth of B16F10-nex2 melanoma tumor. figures.caption: Effects of WT1-pTj on proliferation and clonogenic ability of human melanoma cells.
